title: Returning to Makkah in Peace
paragraphs: After years of exile, the Prophet ﷺ was finally returning to Makkah, not with an army seeking revenge, but with a message of forgiveness toward the very people who had once forced him to leave.
Many were expecting harsh punishment for past enemies who had caused years of suffering, yet instead, he was announcing general amnesty for almost everyone in the city that day.
One former enemy, expecting the worst, was visibly shaking as he approached, only to receive calm reassurance and forgiveness instead of the punishment he had fully anticipated receiving.
This peaceful return is still remembered as a defining example of restraint after victory, showing that real strength often includes the choice to forgive rather than the ability to punish.
